HediffDef.label: counts every coin twice (quirk)
HediffDef.description: Counts the silver twice before anything changes hands, ever since someone cheated them. Traders get a little less past them.

HediffDef.label: walks the fields at dawn (quirk)
HediffDef.description: Walks every row at first light since a crop was lost, and finds the pests and the rot before they spread. A little more comes in at harvest.

HediffDef.label: swears by a healer's salve (quirk)
HediffDef.description: Rubs a healer's salve into every cut and bruise. Wounds close a little sooner.

HediffDef.label: swears by a trick against the cold (quirk)
HediffDef.description: Keeps the frost off the way a traveler from the cold lands showed them: dry wraps, grease on the face, never sweating outdoors. Comfortable a few degrees colder than before.
